body:
### Describe the bug

I have a query that returned a different result between v1.4 & 2.0 (see code snippet later).
Somehow the brackets suddenly disappeared (on 2.0 -- but not all)...
I don't know why they are gone as they shouldn't have.

If you need more information, please ask!

### Optional link from https://docs.sqlalchemy.org which documents the behavior that is expected

_No response_

### SQLAlchemy Version in Use

1.4 & 2.0

### DBAPI (i.e. the database driver)

sqlite

### Database Vendor and Major Version

SQLite 3.38.5

### Python Version

3.9.13

### Operating system

Windows

### To Reproduce

```python
import os
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import create_engine, Column, Integer, Float, String
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from sqlalchemy.ext.declarative import declarative_base

Base = declarative_base()

Path("cities.db").unlink(missing_ok=True)
engine = create_engine("sqlite:///cities.db")


class Location(Base):
    __tablename__ = "cities"
    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    lat = Column(Float)
    lng = Column(Float)
    city_name = Column(String)

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"Location({self.lat}, {self.lng} > {self.city_name})"


Base.metadata.create_all(engine)

Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
session = Session()

session.add_all(
    [
        Location(lat=37.7749, lng=-122.4194, city_name="San Francisco"),
        Location(lat=40.7128, lng=-74.0060, city_name="New York"),
        Location(lat=41.8781, lng=-87.6298, city_name="Chicago"),
        Location(lat=29.7604, lng=-95.3698, city_name="Houston"),
        Location(lat=34.0522, lng=-118.2437, city_name="Los Angeles"),
    ]
)

session.commit()

fudge = 1.2345678
lat = 40
lng = -74

query = session.query(
    Location,
    (lat - Location.lat) * (lat - Location.lat)
    + fudge * (lng - Location.lng) * (lng - Location.lng),
)

print(query)

for row in query.all():
    print(row)

session.close()
```


### Error

```text
SELECT cities.id AS cities_id, cities.lat AS cities_lat, cities.lng AS cities_lng, cities.city_name AS cities_city_name, (? - cities.lat) * (? - cities.lat) + ? * (? - cities.lng) * ? - cities.lng AS anon_1 
FROM cities
(Location(37.7749, -122.4194 > San Francisco), -4296.12990800368)
(Location(40.7128, -74.006 > New York), 73.96593573679998)
(Location(41.8781, -87.6298 > Chicago), -1154.0344432225602)
(Location(29.7604, -95.3698 > Houston), -1752.0833478005597)
(Location(34.0522, -118.2437 > Los Angeles), -3888.3966807516404)
```

Expected:
```text
SELECT cities.id AS cities_id, cities.lat AS cities_lat, cities.lng AS cities_lng, cities.city_name AS cities_city_name, (? - cities.lat) * (? - cities.lat) + ? * (? - cities.lng) * (? - cities.lng) AS anon_1 
FROM cities
(Location(37.7749, -122.4194 > San Francisco), 2899.3190997829124)
(Location(40.7128, -74.006 > New York), 0.508128284440802)
(Location(41.8781, -87.6298 > Chicago), 232.8747075195572)
(Location(29.7604, -95.3698 > Houston), 668.6374508676481)
(Location(34.0522, -118.2437 > Los Angeles), 2452.0489534506064)
```
